def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    valid_mask = bins >= item
    remaining_after = bins[valid_mask] - item
    # Use log(remaining + 1) to avoid log(0) and favor larger remaining space
    priorities[valid_mask] = -np.log(remaining_after + 1)
    return priorities

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    valid_mask = bins >= item
    new_utilization = (bins[valid_mask] - item + item) / bins[valid_mask]
    remaining = bins[valid_mask] - item
    priorities[valid_mask] = new_utilization - (1 / (remaining + 1e-12))
    return priorities
